matched_inputs: identical original retained task population per shape and repetition, linked by both producer and target verifiers
noise_rule: guardrail ratios straddling the 5 percent boundary are inconclusive; all beyond it reject
primary_formula: median over requests within repetition, then median of three repetition medians for first visible output latency
primary_pass: at both concurrency-one lengths candidate <= 0.90 baseline, each paired repetition improves and candidate maximum is below baseline minimum
secondary: at every workload decode TPOT and end-to-end latency <= 1.05 baseline and verified output throughput >= 0.95 baseline; no new errors
